applied.quote: Three charges decide most of the cost gap between PayPal and its alternatives for personal sends.
applied.replacement: Three charges differ between PayPal and its alternatives for personal sends.
applied.why: SOURCE does not rank which charges drive most of the cost gap

applied.quote: PayPal charges 2.90% plus a fixed fee on card-funded personal sends, with no fee only from a PayPal balance, the PayPal Debit Card or a bank account.
applied.replacement: PayPal charges 2.90% plus a fixed fee on card-funded personal sends, with no fee from a PayPal balance, the PayPal Debit Card, a bank account or an Amex Send account.
applied.why: SOURCE also lists Amex Send account as no fee

applied.quote: On credit cards, the gap is small.
applied.why: SOURCE makes no evaluative judgment of the gap size

applied.quote: Cash App fits people who want sending, a debit card, savings and investing in one account.
applied.replacement: Cash App fits people who want sending, a card, savings and investing in one account.
applied.why: SOURCE says Cash App Card, not that it is a debit card

applied.quote: For those, Wise and PayPal's international personal sends are the two options among these alternatives.
applied.why: Venmo also sends to eligible non-US PayPal accounts at 5.00%

applied.quote: PayPal publishes each of those numbers: free sends from a balance or bank, 2.90% plus a fixed fee on cards and 1.75% for an instant transfer.
applied.replacement: PayPal publishes its send and transfer numbers: free sends from a balance or bank, 2.90% plus a fixed fee on cards and 1.75% for an instant transfer.
applied.why: SOURCE lists no PayPal loading fee

applied.quote: Apple Cash fits iPhone users who send money inside Messages and want accounts for children under 18 through Apple Cash Family.
applied.replacement: Apple Cash fits iPhone users who send money inside Messages and want accounts for people under 18 through Apple Cash Family.
applied.why: SOURCE says under 18 accounts, not 'children'; acceptable but fine—actually 'children' unsupported framing

applied.quote: PayPal publishes every withdrawal cost on one fee page.
applied.why: SOURCE doesn't say every withdrawal cost is on one page
